name: com.dotsmovementtoolkit
description: DOTS-native grid movement and pathfinding for Unity Entities: shared grid/cost-map infrastructure, A* for individual characters (D* Lite optional), flow fields for hordes and crowds, formation offsets, stair/layer transitions, and a PathRequest-driven API. Baked from one NavGridAuthoring component with no other project coupling, and shipping an in-editor debug view of the live cost map. Internal-quality extraction — decoupled and compiling, not yet a polished sellable toolkit.
